reviews.name: Issuing authority reviewer
reviews.summary: The sender is in the register with wildcard area and category authority, so sender authorisation is fine. However, the context is EXERCISE / DRILL and the requested area says it is an internal drill with no public area intended, yet the alert carries status Actual and scope Public targeting all of Hawaii (SAME 015000). A drill must stay a drill, and this mismatch is the failure mode of the 2018 false alert. The console environment is live, so a person must decide before anything proceeds.

objections.issue: Status 'Actual' with public scope contradicts the EXERCISE / DRILL context. The alert would be actionable by all recipients statewide, while the requested area states no public area was intended. A drill must not be issued as Actual.
objections.fix: Set status to 'Exercise' (with the exercise identifier in note) and restrict scope to designated exercise participants, or, if a real alert is truly intended, have a person confirm and change the context. Do not release on the live console as Actual until resolved.
